name: replaylist
description: Transfer playlists between Spotify and YouTube

scripts.dev:tauri: concurrently "cd backend && python -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build:backend: pip install --upgrade pip && pip install -r requirements.txt pyinstaller && pyinstaller --noconfirm --onefile --name replaylist-backend backend/entry_server.py
scripts.postbuild:backend:
if not exist tauri\binaries mkdir tauri\binaries && (if exist dist\replaylist-backend.exe copy /Y dist\replaylist-backend.exe tauri\binaries\replaylist-backend.exe) && (if exist dist\replaylist-backend\replaylist-backend.exe copy /Y dist\replaylist-backend\replaylist-backend.exe tauri\binaries\replaylist-backend.exe) && powershell -NoProfile -Command "$py=Split-Path -Parent (Get-Command python).Source; $v=(python - <<PY
import sys
print(f'python{sys.version_info.major}{sys.version_info.minor}.dll')
PY
); $dll=Join-Path $py $v.Trim(); if(Test-Path $dll){ Copy-Item -Force $dll tauri/binaries/python313.dll; Write-Host 'Copied ' $dll } else { Write-Warning 'Python DLL not found: ' $dll }"
scripts.build:app: npm run build:backend && cd tauri && npm run tauri build
